youtube_title: 'Buy Every Dip' Can Empty Your Account 📉 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Throwing all your savings into every market dip? A dip can be the start of a big fall, and nobody knows which one.

Jan 2008: Sensex fell to 17,605 and looked like a dip. Oct 2008: Sensex at 8,701, about 50% lower again. Lump sums into every dip with no plan = cash runs out before the bottom.

Rule: fixed amount every month (SIP), emergency fund first, extra only as per a written plan.
Moral: Invest with a plan, not with FOMO.

Source: BSE Sensex data (Jan & Oct 2008).
Education only, not investment advice.
